description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Detects guard/policy/blocklist contracts that protect a Gnosis Safe but (A) decode a multi-argument Safe self-management selector at the WRONG calldata offset (read the wrong argument), or (B) leave high-impact Safe self-management selectors UNCOVERED while covering others. Two-signal gate: Signal-1 = a Safe-guard selector-filter context (checkTransaction / BaseGuard / selector-from-calldata + revert) that covers >=1 Safe-specific self-mgmt selector; Signal-2 = a concrete decode-offset mismatch OR a missing high-impact selector. Mechanism-based, NOT answer-key string matching. Anchor: reNFT 2024-01 H-04 (gnosis_safe_disable_module_offset = 0x24 reads prevModule not module) + H-02/H-05 (setFallbackHandler / permit not covered). Scope: Safe-management selector coverage + calldata decode only; does NOT detect hostile-token, reentrancy, Seaport, or economic issues.

safe_selectors.name: setGuard
safe_selectors.role: install malicious guard behavior / disable the guard

safe_selectors.name: multiSend
safe_selectors.role: delegate batched execution to attacker-controlled code

safe_selectors.name: increaseAllowance
safe_selectors.role: approve token movement (allowance bypass of approve-block)

fp_controls.two_signal_required: Signal-1 (Safe-guard selector-filter context AND covers >=1 Safe-specific self-mgmt selector) AND Signal-2 (decode-offset mismatch OR missing high-impact selector). A contract that merely contains these selector names without a guard-filter context is suppressed.
fp_controls.mechanism_based: decode_offset_mismatch compares the actual resolved calldata offset used in the selector's branch against the protected-argument offset (e.g. disableModule module @0x44). incomplete_selector_coverage is the set-difference of covered vs required high-impact selectors. Neither matches answer-key strings.
fp_controls.admin_only_downgrade: if the guard/path is admin/owner-gated (not reachable by an untrusted user) -> downgrade to low.
fp_controls.library_suppression: the Safe contracts themselves (Safe/ModuleManager/FallbackManager/BaseGuard) are the thing being guarded, not an integrator guard -> suppressed.
fp_controls.coverage_gate: if the contract covers ZERO Safe-specific self-mgmt selectors (module/fallback/guard/owner), it is not a Safe-management guard (e.g. a plain ERC20 transfer guard) -> no candidate.
